cards.title: Why Birth Rates Are Plummeting
cards.body: Author Camilla Cavendish explores why fewer people are having children, citing dating apps, unaffordable housing, and climate crisis concerns. Understanding these barriers helps explain generational shifts in family planning.

cards.title: Parenting at Ikea: Assessing Your Domestic Wisdom
cards.body: Zoe Williams reflects on taking her son to Ikea and discovering gaps in the domestic wisdom she's imparted. The pre-university shopping trip reveals uncomfortable truths about parenting lessons.

cards.title: When Your Needs Conflict With Your Child's
cards.body: Sometimes parents' needs and children's needs don't align, and choosing yourself can be acceptable. Understanding this balance is crucial for healthy family dynamics.

cards.title: Helping Children With ADHD Find Happiness
cards.body: Kids with ADHD can thrive by focusing on their strengths while addressing challenges. A strength-based approach supports both academic and emotional development.

cards.title: Teaching Kids Kindness and Resisting Hate
cards.body: Parents can help children understand difficult emotions while building empathy and compassion. Teaching kids to resist hate in all forms strengthens their moral foundation.

cards.title: How Children Learn Best
cards.body: The answer to effective child learning is surprisingly intuitive. Understanding optimal learning approaches helps parents and educators support development.

cards.title: Apologies May Not Be Enough for Adult Children
cards.body: Parents who apologize sincerely may still face lingering resentment from adult children over past issues. Understanding that saying sorry is a starting point, not an ending, helps heal relationships.

cards.title: Parents Risk Penalties for Child's Criminal Acts
cards.body: New Parenting Orders reforms could see parents losing benefits or facing prison time for their child's crimes. The policy aims to increase parental accountability in youth delinquency.
